en-US.description: CLI tool and library for generating a Software Bill of Materials from container images and filesystems
en-US.longDescription: Syft is a powerful and easy-to-use open-source tool for generating Software Bill of Materials (SBOMs) for container images and filesystems. It provides detailed visibility into the packages and dependencies in your software, helping you manage vulnerabilities, license compliance, and software supply chain security.
en-US.name: Syft
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added Features
- Add support for scanning IPK packages using the deb-archive-cataloger [PR #5111 @skyhisi]

Bug Fixes
- Pin Gguff lib to prevent dropping packages [PR #5447 @spiffcs]
- Licensing: copyright holder missing, needed for Debian packaging [Issue #5394] [PR #5414 @wagoodman]
- Syft cli.Command() panics when invoked multiple times [Issue #2285] [PR #5386 @JasonMetal]

Additional Changes
- bump go-make module and action together [PR #5415 @wagoodman]
